title: 3D flip card with backface

reference.description: A card centred on stage, front face one colour with a simple glyph, back face a contrasting colour. Holds 0.5 s, flips 180 degrees about its vertical axis over 1.2 s with perspective foreshortening and an overshoot ease, then holds on the back face. The front must never show through the back.

held_tracks: evaluator declares tracks for the front-face colour and the back-face colour; visibility must swap at the 90-degree point
